imposition.cutterMachines.tcp_raw_luu_y: Use only when the cutter exposes a raw TCP port and accepts PLT/HPGL directly. An open port does not guarantee command compatibility.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_scope_warning: First identify how your cutter normally receives jobs. A network socket does not necessarily mean PrynX can send cutting commands directly. If you normally open vendor software and use Import/Open, choose Save file.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_choose_title: Should I choose LAN or Save file?
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_choose_lan_body: Only when the cutter has an IP address and its documentation explicitly supports direct PLT/HPGL over TCP/IP—for example IP 192.168.1.50 and port 9100 supplied by the installer.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_choose_file_body: Use this for USB/COM cutters, Windows printer drivers, or vendor-controlled software. PrynX creates a PLT/DXF/PDF file; import that file in the cutter software.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step1_body: Check the manual or the cutter Network screen for TCP/IP, RAW, HPGL/PLT, IP address, and port. Do not assume port 9100 when the cutter documentation specifies another port.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step2_title: Put the cutter and computer on the same network.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step2_body: Connect both to the same router or switch, preferably over Ethernet. Record the cutter IP and use a static IP or DHCP reservation so it does not change after a restart.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step3_title: Select the correct profile and settings.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step3_body: Choose the matching vendor/model profile, Machine command (PLT), and LAN (TCP/IP), then enter the cutter IP and documented port. Generic HPGL is only for cutters compatible with HPGL PU/PD.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step4_body: A green result means the computer can open the TCP port. This test sends no command and does not move the blade. On failure, check IP, port, cabling, Wi-Fi isolation, VPN, and firewall settings.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_step5_body: Use a small shape, low speed and pressure, test material, and stay near the emergency stop. Verify size, coordinate origin, Y direction, and command dialect before production.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_timeout: Timeout usually means a wrong IP, different network, VPN/Wi-Fi isolation, or firewall blocking traffic.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_refused: Connection refused means the device was reached but the port is closed or its TCP service is disabled.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_open_no_cut: Port opens but nothing cuts: wrong profile/dialect, no raw PLT/HPGL support, or a vendor-specific handshake is required.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_usb: USB/COM/driver-only cutter: choose Save file and import PLT/DXF/PDF into the vendor application; raw TCP does not apply.
imposition.cutterMachines.guide_terms_body: IP is the cutter network address, for example 192.168.1.50. Port is its data entry number, for example 9100. PLT/HPGL is a language of blade movement commands. Raw TCP means PrynX sends those commands directly without vendor software.
imposition.cutterMachines.ma_may_id_chi_gom_chu_so_gach_duoi: Machine ID (id) may only contain letters/digits/underscores, no spaces.
imposition.cutterMachines.cau_hinh_ket_noi_kenh_gui_ip_thu_muc_cho: Configure the connection (send channel / IP / folder) for each machine. Add new machines for different machine lines (China, HPGL...). When you click "Send to Cutter", picking a machine automatically uses the config here.

preprocess.numbering.help_intro: Auto Numbering fills a sequence of numbers/tickets onto the positions you place on the PDF page, then prints many sheets. Use it for lottery tickets, gift vouchers, serial-numbered stamps, invoices...
preprocess.numbering.help_slot_noi_dung: Each box you drop onto the page is a Slot. A single sheet can hold many Slots (many tickets/stamps at once). The software spreads the number sequence into the Slots by reading order, then moves to the next sheet. You can Group several fields into one Slot so they all receive the same number.
preprocess.numbering.help_che_do_range: Count continuously from a start number to an end number by a step. Example 1 → 1000. Add prefix/suffix and zero-padding if needed (No.0001).
preprocess.numbering.help_che_do_set: Split into multiple sets, each set restarting from the beginning. Example A-01…A-50, B-01…B-50. Use the display structure {%b} for the set and {%t} for the sequence number.
preprocess.numbering.help_sort_noi_dung: Decides which direction the numbers run when there are many Slots on a sheet: by Row (Z), by Column (N), U-shape, or circular. Pick the right one so numbers increase in the direction you want on the printed sheet.
preprocess.numbering.help_phanbo_linear: Numbers run in order on each sheet: sheet 1 carries 1,2,3…; sheet 2 carries the next numbers. After printing, stack in sheet order and it reads correctly right away.
preprocess.numbering.help_phanbo_stack: For cut & stack machines: numbers jump across sheets so that after printing, when you cut the paper stack and pile the halves, the numbers run continuously within each pile. Choosing this mode wrongly will make the numbers jump around after cutting.
preprocess.numbering.help_ghi_chu: Tip: check the Preview panel below to verify the first few sheets before creating the file. Enable Random shuffle for raffle tickets.
